payload.notes: Current-source Debug EVID-20260828T124332Z-1e2a050c0e and Release EVID-20260828T124624Z-00a3dd27c2 each pass 657 warnings-as-errors tests with four expected host-dependent skips. The full four-path atomic RENAME_SWAP matrix, fixed 32-slot receipt ledger, unsafe-rollback refusal, combined namespace-instability and durability failures, and two-receipt recovery merge are covered. Descriptor-relative operations and renameatx_np mitigate but do not eliminate the final verifier-to-terminal-syscall race because public macOS APIs have no expected-identity conditional mutation. One winning race can mutate one entry under the pinned parent; a final-link unlink can lose unbounded bytes and a directory rename can relocate an unbounded subtree. One recursive request can expose up to 100000 separate opportunities; 32 bounds simultaneous cooperative recovery state only. Terminal namespace syscalls and fsync already executing under the ledger lock have no independent wall-time deadline. Initial path anchoring, destination hierarchy creation, and hard-link ctime ambiguity remain E2.
payload.title: Filesystem mutation paths retain descriptor-relative race windows
